settlements.name: Mantis
settlements.notes: An oasis town on the Bowl's salt lake (moved 2026-10-23: from 831,816, under the 4.21 lake, to the heart of the wettest pocket on its south-west shore: Am, ~1,550 mm, -976 m, 2 km from the water; the pocket is ~330 km2 of monsoon forest and savanna in the hot desert). An Iziz holding: grew under Yuni's influence, later taken over by Izani merchant houses. Named after the Bowl mantis, a large predator of the region. See biomes/sedesert/PLAN-BOWL.md.

settlements.name: Pinnacle Rock
settlements.notes: Beast Rider roost town on a red sandstone mesa (settlements/pinnacle-rock/PLAN.md). Moved 2026-10-18 from px 737,354 (approximate) to the knoll that clears the forest: 500-600 m over the jungle floor, the K'etsaal Baatar 11 km off.

lakes.name: flood lake
lakes.note: every dam lake's water over its sill, pooled where the last breach ends; the body there taken at its level today (the owner, 2026-10-20)
